title: 第一卷 第259章 征服阴婆婆第一卷 第258章 活捉阴婆婆
slug: 百岁成魔开局拿捏妖女命脉
content_zh:
阴灵月瘫坐在暗红色阵壁边缘，灰色长袍上沾满了尘土和血迹，苍白的脸上浮着几道细小的伤痕。暗紫色的眼眸中满是疲倦和不甘，连呼吸都带着一种力竭后的急促。
李寒山收起断剑，蹲下身，一连在她体内下了十几道禁制。这些禁制是洛璃教他的上古手法，专门用于封禁修士的灵力运转。阴灵月的丹田被他封得死死的，连一丝灵力都调动不了。
当然，她是化神，一旦她恢复过来，还是有可能挣掉的。
只不过呢，李寒山不会让她恢复的。
“你……”阴灵月咬着唇，暗紫色的眼眸盯着他，“你想怎么样？”
李寒山没有立刻回答，站起身来，负手打量着面前这个被他活捉的化神女修。
说实话，他自己都有些意外。一开始只是打算断后，让小安顺利突破，然后能打就打，能撤就撤，没想过真能把她留下。
可现在，她确实坐在他脚边，浑身灵力被封，连站都站不起来。活捉一个化神修士，这可是实打实的战利品。化神修士的价值远超元婴，光是她的储物袋就足以让他发一笔横财，更别提她的身体本身。
“没想到，居然能活捉一个化神。”他开口，语气中带着几分感慨，像是在自言自语，“阴婆婆，你追杀我的时候，有没有想过自己会有今天？”
阴灵月别过头去，没有说话。她的长发散落在肩侧，遮住了半边脸颊，但李寒山能看到她攥紧的拳头正在微微发抖。那不是恐惧，更像是一种被彻底击败后强行压制的愤怒。
“你想求饶？”他蹲下身，伸手捏住她的下巴，强迫她转过头来与自己对视。那双暗紫色的眼眸中倒映着他的脸，带着一种她极力压制却依旧泄露了痕迹的屈辱。阴灵月咬紧牙关，沉默了很久，最终还是从齿缝里挤出一句沙哑的话：“你想要什么？灵石？功法？本座都可以给你……”
李寒山摇了摇头，松开她的下巴，站起身来。他低头看着她，嘴角浮现出一丝玩味的笑意：“阴婆婆，我还是喜欢你桀骜不驯的样子。求饶？太没意思了。”
阴灵月的脸色微微一变。她盯着他，暗紫色的眼眸中闪过一丝复杂的光芒，像是想说什么，却又咽了回去。
李寒山不再看她，转身走向那具银尸。在小安的魂力压制下，银尸身上的暗红色光芒已经彻底熄灭，只有偶尔跳动的蓝色光点证明它还在小安的控制之下。他抬手按在银尸的符文核心处，纯阳之火化作细如发丝的金线探入其中，沿着符文的纹路走了一圈。那些被血煞之气冲击得错位的纹路被他一一拨回原位，又将小安留下的魂力印记重新加固了一遍。
做完这一切，他拍了拍手上的灰，转向小安：“你怎么样？”
小安的魂体比突破时凝实了许多，虽然气息还有些不稳，显然突破化神后需要时间稳固，但精神不错。她朝他点了点头：“前辈放心，我没事。只是需要一些时间消化。”
“那就先休息。”李寒山从储物戒指中取出一些灵石递给她，“这些你拿着，慢慢炼化。”
阴魂虽然以吸收阴气为主，灵石也仍然是需要的。
小安接过灵石，化作一道黑光钻回魂幡之中，再无声息。做完这一切，他重新转向阴灵月。
阴灵月靠在阵壁边缘，因为力竭而微微喘息着，那头乌黑的长发凌乱地披散在肩上，灰色长袍的襟口被扯开了半寸，露出一截精致的锁骨。她感应到他的目光落回自己身上，身体不自觉地绷紧了。

李寒山走近她，在她面前蹲下，伸手拨开她额前散落的发丝。阴灵月的身体猛地一僵，她想要后退，却被身后的阵壁挡住，退无可退。她的目光死死盯着他，暗紫色的眼眸中带着一种极力维持的平静，但那平静之下翻涌着压抑不住的怒火与羞愤。
“你要做什么？”她的声音沙哑，却依旧带着一股倔强的冷意。
李寒山没有回答。他看着她那张被伪装掩盖了数百年的脸——五官精致，肤白如玉，即便狼狈至此依旧带着一股让人移不开眼的高傲。他伸手捏住她的衣襟边缘，将灰色长袍的布料从肩头剥落。
阴灵月的身体猛地绷紧了。她想要挣扎，却连抬起手臂的力气都没有了。灵力被尽数封住，身上又带着多处伤，她只能死死盯着面前这个老头，暗紫色的眼眸中翻涌着几乎要溢出来的怒意和屈辱。
“我可是合欢宗的人，所以不要指望我手下留情。”李寒山的声音平静，他没有再说话，直接用行动表明了他的意图。合欢宗出身的他，做这种事轻车熟路。
衣料滑落的窸窣声响在安静的阵壁内格外清晰。阴灵月仰头望着阵壁上流转的暗红色符文，那双暗紫色的眼眸中没有任何泪水，只是空茫地睁着。
她本以为会被直接采补致死，已经做好了鱼死网破的准备。可他没有急于汲取她的灵力，也没有将她当成一次性消耗品对待。他只是将她压在阵壁边缘，纯阳之气沿着两人相接之处缓缓流入她的经脉。那股气息温润而坚定，没有掠夺的意图，只是在试探性地寻找着什么。
阴灵月茫然地感知着那股流入她体内的纯阳之气，正要将他推开，然而下一刻，她的身体猛地绷紧了。一股陌生的力量从她小腹处升腾而起，沿着经脉向丹田蔓延，如同被种下了一粒尚未发芽的种子。她下意识地想要抗拒，却被那股力量轻轻弹开，连触碰都做不到。她的脸色终于彻底变了：“你在我体内放了什么？”
李寒山没有回答。他俯下身，将她的衣服彻底撕开，然后压住她。
一滴眼泪，从阴灵月的眼角滑落。
李寒山没有丝毫怜悯。
阴灵月可是一个魔宗的大魔头，不知道有多少人死在她手上，现在不过是被他夺了身子而已。
她的身子，倒还是第一次。
李寒山很受用。
纯阳之气在她体内循环了一圈又一圈，将那粒种子在灵气循环中反复催化、滋养，让它以一种缓慢而坚定的速度向她的丹田深处扎根。
阴灵月挣扎了几次，都被他更用力地按了回去，最终她咬着牙别过头去不再看他，任由李寒山施为。
只是，那双暗紫色的眼眸中翻涌着屈辱与不甘交织的光芒。
这一夜，阵壁上的暗红色光芒在他们的影子中明灭不定。
阴灵月红着脸，闭着眼，咬着唇，将所有的声音都压回喉咙深处。

content_en:
Yin Lingyue sat slumped on the edge of the dark red formation wall. Her gray robe was stained with dust and blood, and there were a few small scars on her pale face. His dark purple eyes were full of fatigue and unwillingness, and even his breathing was rapid with exhaustion.
Li Hanshan put away the broken sword, squatted down, and placed more than a dozen restraints in her body. These restrictions were ancient techniques taught to him by Luo Li, specifically used to restrict the movement of monks' spiritual power. Yin Lingyue's Dantian was sealed tightly by him, and he couldn't mobilize even a trace of spiritual power.
Of course, she is a god incarnation, so once she recovers, it is still possible to break free.
It's just that Li Hanshan will not let her recover.
"You..." Yin Lingyue bit her lip and stared at him with her dark purple eyes, "What do you want?"
Li Hanshan did not answer immediately. He stood up and looked at the female cultivator in front of him who had been captured alive.
To be honest, he himself was a little surprised. At first, I just planned to cut off the queen, allowing Xiao An to break through smoothly, and then attack when I could and retreat when I could. I never thought I could really keep her.
But now, she was indeed sitting at his feet, her spiritual power was blocked and she couldn't even stand up. Capturing a god-transformation monk alive is a real trophy. The value of the cultivator of the Transformation God far exceeds that of the Nascent Soul. Her storage bag alone is enough to make him a fortune, not to mention her body itself.
"I didn't expect that I could capture an Avatar alive." He spoke with a bit of emotion in his tone, as if he was talking to himself, "Grandma Yin, when you were chasing me, did you ever think that you would be where you are today?"
Yin Lingyue turned away and said nothing. Her long hair was scattered around her shoulders, covering half of her face, but Li Hanshan could see that her clenched fists were trembling slightly. It wasn't fear, it was more like a suppressed anger after being completely defeated.
"Do you want to beg for mercy?" He squatted down, reached out and pinched her chin, forcing her to turn her head to look at him. His face was reflected in those dark purple eyes, with a sense of humiliation that she tried her best to suppress but still showed traces of. Yin Lingyue gritted her teeth and was silent for a long time. Finally, she squeezed out a hoarse word from between her teeth: "What do you want? Spiritual stones? Kung Fu? I can give it to you..."
Li Hanshan shook his head, released her chin, and stood up. He looked down at her, with a playful smile on his lips: "Grandma Yin, I still like your unruly look. Begging for mercy? It's so boring."
Yin Lingyue's expression changed slightly. She stared at him, a complicated light flashing in her dark purple eyes, as if she wanted to say something, but swallowed it back.
Li Hanshan stopped looking at her and turned towards the silver corpse. Under the suppression of Xiao An's soul power, the dark red light on the silver corpse has been completely extinguished, and only the occasional blue light spot proves that it is still under Xiao An's control. He raised his hand and pressed it on the core of the rune of the silver corpse. The pure Yang fire turned into a golden thread as thin as a hair and penetrated it, following the lines of the rune. He moved the lines that had been displaced by the blood evil energy back to their original positions one by one, and reinforced the soul mark left by Xiao An.
After doing all this, he patted the dust on his hands and turned to Xiao An: "How are you?"
Xiao An's soul body is much more solid than when he broke through. Although his aura is still a little unstable, obviously it will take time to stabilize after breaking through to the spirit form, but his spirit is good. She nodded towards him: "Senior, don't worry, I'm fine. I just need some time to digest."
"Then rest first." Li Hanshan took out some spiritual stones from the storage ring and handed them to her, "Take these and slowly refine them."
Although Yinhun mainly absorbs Yin Qi, spirit stones are still needed.
Xiao An took the spirit stone and turned it into a black light and went back into the soul flag, making no sound again. After doing all this, he turned to Yin Lingyue again.
Yin Lingyue leaned against the edge of the formation wall, panting slightly due to exhaustion. Her long black hair was messy and scattered on her shoulders. The gray robeThe lapel was torn open half an inch, revealing a delicate collarbone. She felt his eyes fall back on her, and her body tensed unconsciously.
Li Hanshan approached her, squatted down in front of her, and reached out to brush away the scattered hair from her forehead. Yin Lingyue's body stiffened suddenly. She wanted to retreat, but was blocked by the formation wall behind her, making it impossible to retreat. Her eyes were fixed on him, with a kind of calmness she tried to maintain in her dark purple eyes, but under that calmness surged uncontrollable anger and shame.
"What are you going to do?" Her voice was hoarse, but still had a stubborn coldness to it.
Li Hanshan did not answer. He looked at her face that had been covered by disguise for hundreds of years - her facial features were exquisite, her skin was as white as jade, and even though she was in such a state of embarrassment, she still had a sense of arrogance that people couldn't look away from. He reached out and pinched the edge of her dress, peeling the fabric of the gray robe off her shoulders.
Yin Lingyue's body suddenly tensed up. She wanted to struggle, but she didn't even have the strength to lift her arms. With all her spiritual power sealed and her body carrying many injuries, she could only stare at the old man in front of her, her dark purple eyes filled with anger and humiliation that was almost overflowing.
"I'm from the Hehuan Sect, so don't expect me to be merciful." Li Hanshan's voice was calm. He didn't speak anymore and directly expressed his intention with actions. Coming from the Hehuan Sect, he was very familiar with doing this kind of thing.
The rustling sound of clothing sliding down was particularly clear in the quiet array wall. Yin Lingyue looked up at the dark red runes flowing on the formation wall. There were no tears in her dark purple eyes, they were just open blankly.
She originally thought that she would be directly harvested to death, and she was already prepared to fight to the death. But he didn't rush to absorb her spiritual power, nor did he treat her as a disposable consumable. He just pressed her against the edge of the formation wall, and the pure Yang Qi slowly flowed into her meridians along the point where the two of them met. The breath was warm and firm, with no intention of plundering, but just tentatively looking for something.
Yin Lingyue felt the pure Yang energy flowing into her body blankly, and was about to push him away, but the next moment, her body suddenly tightened. A strange force rose from her lower abdomen and spread along her meridians toward her Dantian, as if a seed had been planted that had not yet sprouted. She subconsciously wanted to resist, but was gently bounced away by the force, unable to even touch him. Her expression finally changed completely: "What did you put in my body?"
Li Hanshan did not answer. He leaned down, tore her clothes completely apart, and then pressed her down.
A tear slipped from the corner of Yin Lingyue's eyes.
Li Hanshan showed no mercy.
Yin Lingyue is a big demon of the Demon Sect. I don’t know how many people died at her hands, but now they are just taken away by him.
This was the first time for her body.
Li Hanshan is very useful.
The pure Yang Qi circulated in her body, catalyzing and nourishing the seed repeatedly in the spiritual energy cycle, allowing it to take root deep in her Dantian at a slow but firm speed.
Yin Lingyue struggled several times, but was pushed back harder by him. Finally, she gritted her teeth and looked away from him, letting Li Hanshan do what he did.
However, those dark purple eyes were filled with a mixture of humiliation and unwillingness.
That night, the dark red light on the formation wall flickered in and out of their shadows.
Yin Lingyue blushed, closed her eyes, bit her lip, and suppressed all the sounds deep in her throat.
